notes: Shopify store, HTTP fetch (curl) tier-1 only, no bot protection encountered, no Claude-specific robots.txt disallow. Discovery: fetched sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml (375 collection handles) and home page nav HTML; grepped for best/top-sell/popular/favorite/trend/customer-favorite keywords. Main nav has NO 'Best Sellers' menu item (only product-level 'Best Seller' badge tag used across the catalog: badge_copy "Best Seller", tag_name "badge:BestSeller"), but a standalone /collections/best-sellers page exists (found via sitemap), is a genuine PLP (268 unique product IDs via exhaustion-paged /products.json), and its own H1/title is 'Our Most-Loved Styles' -- matches target concept 'Customer Favorites'/'Most Popular'. Kept as the single Bestsellers row. Other candidates checked and EXCLUDED: /collections/our-favorites (H1 'Our favorites', but products.json returns {"products":[]} -- genuinely 0 products right now, dropped per zero-product rule); /collections/selling-fast (H1 'Deals selling fast', 310 products, but 0/310 overlap with the Clearance listing and 215/310 overlap with the generic Sale hub (shop-all-sale) -- this is an inventory-urgency/deals page tied to the temporary Sale promotion, not a bestseller/popularity-ranking concept, excluded); /collections/trendy-nook, /collections/trendy-blush, /collections/dark-brown-trend -- confirmed via page title to be color/style theme collections ('Trendy Nook', 'Trendy Blush', 'Dark Brown trend'), unrelated to bestseller merchandising, excluded. No French-language duplicate needed (default storefront serves English; robots.txt/sitemap show a parallel /fr/ tree but no separate bestseller concept was found there in nav). Did not use site search since robots.txt disallows /search and nav+sitemap fully covered discovery per brief section 4.

rows.evidence: Exhaustion-verified unique product-ID count via paged https://www.bouclair.com/collections/best-sellers/products.json?limit=250 (2 pages: 250+18=268 unique IDs, no duplicates across pages). Page <title>/<h1>: 'Our Most-Loved Styles'.
